zh-CN.title: 位置探索始终停留在地球上
items: 位置页取消世界与国家切换，不再突然进入二维平面地图
地球仪先聚焦国家，再渲染省级边界并继续放大到具体位置

en.title: Location journeys now stay on the globe
items: Location views no longer switch between world and country tabs or jump into a flat map
The globe first approaches the country, reveals regional boundaries, then continues into the exact place
